adhd: On /adhd, "adhd mode" or "I have ADHD": next action first, short numbered steps.
brainstorm: New feature or project with no design, "brainstorm", "interview me": spec first.
brick-forge: New or changed loop brick, "make a brick", "change the test brick": write it.
bruno: Bruno API collection, .bru files, OpenCollection YAML: create, convert, test.
codebase-design: "Where should the seam go", module interface, glossary term, ADR: deep modules.
commit: About to commit changes: stage only the task's paths, one focused message.
compose-ops: compose.yaml, docker-compose, Dockerfile: health, volumes, pins, secrets.
council: "Convene a council", "debate this", "argue both sides": viewpoints, a ruling.
daydream: On /daydream: find hidden links between notes in an Obsidian vault.
debug: Bug: failing test, crash, an error or stack trace, wrong return value, red CI.
deck: Presentation, slides or a deck, no file format named: one offline HTML file.
dependencies: "What's outdated", "are we vulnerable", audit or upgrade dependencies, CVEs.
develop: Implement a feature, fix a bug, change behaviour: test first, then code, green.
diagram-design: Diagram, chart, flowchart, architecture, sequence, ER, Gantt: HTML/SVG output.
document-project: Docs missing or drifted, PRD, architecture doc, AGENTS.md: write them from code.
explain-changes: "What did you change", "show me the diff", explain a PR: one offline HTML page.
factory: Factory named, issue-to-pr, bug-report-to-fix: carry one item to a green PR.
factory-forge: New factory, or change one: compose bricks and loops into a checked factory.
forge-mcp: Build, extend or harden an MCP server that exposes an API as agent tools.
fresh-eyes: Work claimed done, needs a blind check: a context-free agent judges the ask.
frontend-design: New UI or redesign needing a point of view: palette, type, layout, no template.
geneseed: Geneseed, the harness, AGENT.md: install, upgrade, repair, OpenCode theme.
geneseed-code-review: Review a diff or PR before merge, "roast my code": correctness first.
git-history: Learn from git history (bisect, blame, pickaxe), or repair or rewrite it safely.
gitlab-ci: .gitlab-ci.yml, GitLab pipeline jobs: rules, needs, includes, cache, variables.
handoff: Context filling, session ending mid-task, work passing on: write the state down.
herdr: Only when the user names Herdr: drive its panes, tabs, workspaces and agents.
ingest: Read a PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, EPUB, HTML or a URL: convert to markdown.
jenkins-pipeline: Jenkinsfile, Jenkins shared library, CPS or sandbox error: write or fix it.
learn-mode: User wants to learn while building: they design each part, the agent explains.
loop: "Run a loop", small validated iterations each committed: work a requirement.
opencode-cli: Drive OpenCode V2 from a script or session: opencode run, sessions, server, MCP.
ownership: Developer must own production code: they decide each part, the agent proposes.
parallel-agents: Two or more independent subtasks, no shared state: fan out to parallel agents.
pipeline: User asks for a pipeline or crew, or a big multi-specialist task: worktree crew.
plan: Task with several steps or files: write a plan file first, track each step.
profile: User wants the agent to know who they are, PROFILE.md a stub: interview, draft.
prose: Human-facing prose (commit body, PR, docs, reply): write it so it reads human.
prototype: Design question needing a runnable answer, "does this feel right": prototype.
react: React components, hooks, state, data fetching in a Vite or webpack app (TS/JS).
react-testing: React tests with Jest, Testing Library, MSW: write or fix them.
react-view-transitions: React View Transition API: page transitions, shared elements, route animations.
refactor: Extract, rename, inline, split, dedupe working code; behaviour stays the same.
release: User asks to cut or publish a release: version bump, changelog, tag, in sync.
research: Needs current or external facts, not in the repo or the model: sourced answer.
review-response: Review feedback arrived, from a human or agent: verify each point, then act.
roast-me: User wants their own ask, plan, idea or writing torn apart, brutally, honestly.
rule: "Always", "never", "from now on", "remember that", auto-merge on/off: record it.
security-audit: Security review, threat model, "is this safe", auth or input change: audit it.
ship: Change committed and verified: open the pull request, or merge the branch.
skill-forge: Task repeats and no skill covers it, or a skill to sharpen, merge or retire.
spring-boot: Spring Boot 4 service: controllers, config, security, HTTP clients, logging.
spring-data-jpa: Spring Data JPA, Hibernate, N+1, LazyInitializationException, migrations.
teach: User asks to be taught something, or to have what they know tested: teach, quiz.
token-report: Token or context usage, "how full is the context", what eats it: tables report.
wayfinder: Work too big for one session, route unclear: map it as decision tickets.
wiki: Needs the user's machine-wide knowledge base, or a cross-project fact to save.
workflow: Deterministic multi-agent orchestration, host has a workflow tool: run a script.
worktree: "Worktree", "isolate this", work must not share the checkout: own git worktree.
